questions.question: A shopkeeper offered successive discounts of 10% and 15% on an article with the marked price of Rs. 28,000. Find the selling price of the article.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Net multiplier for **successive discounts** of 10% and 15% = 0.90 × 0.85 = 0.765

**Selling Price** = **Marked Price** × Net multiplier

⇒ SP = 28,000 × 0.765

⇒ SP = 21,420

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 21,420.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Marked Price (MP)** = Rs. 28,000

**First Discount (d₁)** = 10%

**Second Discount (d₂)** = 15%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6565a0267c7c2b95dd624221dee41542cbe60c57f06e9919c690ea9ac6a01fac.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 28,000 − (10% of 28,000)

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 28,000 − 2,800 = Rs. 25,200

⇒ **Selling Price** = 25,200 − (15% of 25,200)

⇒ SP = 25,200 − (15/100 × 25,200)

⇒ SP = 25,200 − 3,780

⇒ SP = Rs. 21,420

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 21,420.**

**__Additional Information__**

Single Equivalent Discount

For two successive discounts of x% and y%, the single equivalent discount is calculated as (x + y − xy/100)%.

Relationship between MP and SP

Selling Price = Marked Price × (100 − Discount%)/100. Discounts are always calculated on the **Marked Price** unless stated otherwise.

Successive Percentage Change

Final Value = Initial Value × (1 ± r₁/100) × (1 ± r₂/100), where r represents the rate of increase (+) or decrease (−).</p

questions.question: The traffic lights at three different crossings turn red after every 30 sec, 45 sec and 60 sec, respectively. If they all tum red simultaneously at 8:30 a.m., then at what time will they again turn red simultaneously?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Find the **LCM** of the given time intervals: 30, 45, and 60.

LCM(30, 45, 60) = **180 seconds**.

Convert 180 seconds to minutes: 180 ÷ 60 = **3 minutes**.

Add the interval to the initial time: 8:30 a.m. + 3 minutes = **8:33 a.m.**

**∴ The correct answer is 8:33 a.m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Intervals are 30 sec, 45 sec, and 60 sec. Starting time = 8:30 a.m.

**Formula:** Simultaneous occurrence time = LCM of individual intervals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/693e934a8b8689c23c19bed4cbba3ab362b6c30bb88d97fe0b7d8ab05fa45c03.png] 

⇒ Prime factors of 30 = 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ Prime factors of 45 = 3² × 5

⇒ Prime factors of 60 = 2² × 3 × 5

⇒ LCM = 2² × 3² × 5 = 4 × 9 × 5 = 180 seconds

⇒ 180 seconds = 180 ÷ 60 minutes = 3 minutes

⇒ Next simultaneous time = 8:30:00 + 0:03:00 = 8:33 a.m.

**∴ The correct answer is 8:33 a.m.**

**__Additional Information__**

LCM Application

**LCM (Least Common Multiple)** is used to find the first instance when multiple periodic events with different frequencies occur at the same time.

Time Conversion

Always ensure all units are consistent. **60 seconds = 1 minute** and **60 minutes = 1 hour**.

Successive Occurrences

To find the nth simultaneous occurrence, use the formula: **Start Time + (n × LCM)**.</p

questions.question: What sum of money will amount to Rs. 1,116 at 4% per annum simple interest in 6 years?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

In **Simple Interest**, Total % Interest = **Rate × Time**.

Total Interest = 4% × 6 = 24%.

Amount % = Principal (100%) + Interest (24%) = 124%.

124% = ₹1,116 ⇒ 1% = 9 ⇒ 100% = ₹900.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹900.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Amount (A)** = ₹1,116

**Rate (R)** = 4% per annum

**Time (T)** = 6 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount = Principal × (1 + (R × T) ÷ 100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de3731cfdacec3dac1663e4f87fe2676b35b49545c701c0336cb162f6db4e18e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1,116 = P × (1 + (4 × 6) ÷ 100)

⇒ 1,116 = P × (1 + 24 ÷ 100)

⇒ 1,116 = P × (124 ÷ 100)

⇒ P = (1,116 × 100) ÷ 124

⇒ P = 9 × 100

⇒ P = ₹900

**∴ The correct answer is ₹900.**

**__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

The basic formula for SI is (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is **Principal**, R is **Rate**, and T is **Time**.

Difference between SI and CI

In **Simple Interest**, interest is calculated only on the principal, whereas in **Compound Interest**, interest is calculated on the principal plus the accumulated interest.

Relationship between Amount and Principal

Amount (A) is always the sum of **Principal (P)** and **Interest (I)**. i.e., A = P + I.

questions.question: If 30% of a number exceeds 20% of it by 12, then the number is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **number** be 100%.

Difference in percentages = 30% − 20% = 10%.

Given, 10% of the number = 12.

So, 100% of the number = 12 × 10 = 120.

**∴ The correct answer is 120.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**First percentage** = 30%

**Second percentage** = 20%

**Difference value** = 12

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef0a969034c76f0068c81a60c2aea9ccf444383ed3c3dc38e7f023e3fea7873b.png] 

**Calculation:**

Let the **number** be x.

⇒ (30/100) × x − (20/100) × x = 12

⇒ (10/100) × x = 12

⇒ 0.1x = 12

⇒ x = 12 ÷ 0.1

⇒ x = 120

**∴ The correct answer is 120.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Difference

When comparing two percentages of the same base, the absolute difference in value is equal to the difference in percentages multiplied by the base value (Number × (P₁% − P₂%) = Difference).

Base Value Concept

In percentage problems, the original number is always considered as 100% unless specified otherwise.</p

questions.question: The perimeter of a rhombus is 148 cm, and one of its diagonals is 24 cm. The area in cm² of the rhombus is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of **rhombus** (a) = **Perimeter** ÷ 4 = 148 ÷ 4 = 37 cm.

In a **rhombus**, the half-diagonals (d₁/2, d₂/2) and the side (a) form a **Pythagorean triplet**.

Half-diagonal 1 = 24 ÷ 2 = 12 cm. Using triplet (12, 35, 37), half-diagonal 2 = 35 cm.

**Area** = 2 × (d₁/2 × d₂/2) = 2 × 12 × 35 = 840 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 840 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Perimeter** = 148 cm, Diagonal 1 (d₁) = 24 cm.

**Formula Used:** Side (a) = Perimeter ÷ 4; Area = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂; Relationship: a² = (d₁/2)² + (d₂/2)².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a88ec326946f092db29089a2ce14897a553c9e13c44cfffe7f09b58652ef64f6.png] 

⇒ Side (a) = 148 ÷ 4 = 37 cm

⇒ (d₂/2)² = a² − (d₁/2)²

⇒ (d₂/2)² = 37² − 12² = 1369 − 144 = 1225

⇒ d₂/2 = √1225 = 35 cm ⇒ d₂ = 70 cm

⇒ Area = (1/2) × 24 × 70 = 12 × 70 = 840 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 840 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rhombus

All sides are equal and diagonals bisect each other at right angles (90°).

Area of Rhombus

Area = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂ or Area = base × height.

Side-Diagonal Relation

4a² = d₁² + d₂², where 'a' is the side and d₁, d₂ are diagonals.</p

questions.question: Pipe R can empty a full tank in 30 hours. But two pipes P and Q can fill the tank in 15 hours and 10 hours, respectively. Ram unknowingly opened all three taps. After 2 hours Shyam realised it and closed Pipe R. Due to this mistake how much time more would it take to fill the tank?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work (LCM of 15, 10, 30) = 30 units.

Efficiencies: P = +2, Q = +3, R = −1. Combined (P+Q+R) = 4.

Work done in 2 hours = 4 × 2 = 8 units. Remaining = 30 − 8 = 22 units.

Time with P and Q only = 22 ÷ 5 = 4.4 hours (4 hr 24 min).

Time if R was never open = 30 ÷ 5 = 6 hours. But from t=0, P+Q take 30/5 = 6 hours. After 2 hours, they would need 4 hours. Extra time = 4 hr 24 min − 4 hr = 24 min.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 min.**

questions.question:
Which of the following statements about the principal focus of a spherical mirror is/are correct?

(a) It always lies midway between the pole and the centre of curvature.

(b) Its position depends on the size of the mirror.

(c) It always lies at the centre of curvature.
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Only (a)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **principal focus** of a **spherical mirror** is the point where rays of light parallel to the principal axis converge (in a concave mirror) or appear to diverge from (in a convex mirror) after reflection.
 
• For a **concave mirror**, the principal focus lies midway between the **pole** (the center of the mirror's surface) and the **center of curvature** (the center of the sphere of which the mirror is a part).
 
• The **position of the principal focus** does not depend on the size of the mirror. It is always at a fixed distance, which is half the radius of curvature (i.e., focal length = radius of curvature / 2).
 
• For a **convex mirror**, the principal focus is also located midway between the pole and the center of curvature but appears to be behind the mirror.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Its position depends on the size of the mirror**__

 __
 
• This statement is incorrect because the position of the principal focus is determined by the radius of curvature and not by the size of the mirror.
 
• The focal length remains constant for a given mirror regardless of its size.
 
 
 
• **It always lies at the centre of curvature**__
 
 
• This statement is incorrect because the principal focus is distinct from the center of curvature. The center of curvature is twice the distance from the mirror compared to the principal focus.

Average of first n **even** numbers is (n + 1). Average of first n **odd** numbers is n.</p

questions.question: A gas can be liquefied by _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**high pressure and low temperature**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gases can be liquefied by increasing the **pressure** and decreasing the **temperature**.
 
• Increasing the **pressure** forces gas molecules closer together, promoting the formation of a liquid phase.
 
• Decreasing the **temperature** reduces the kinetic energy of the gas molecules, making it easier for intermolecular forces to hold the molecules together in a liquid state.
 
• These principles are based on the **Ideal Gas Law** and **Phase Diagrams** which describe the state of matter under different conditions of pressure and temperature.
 
• Liquefaction of gases is a fundamental process in the production and storage of **liquefied natural gas (LNG)**, **liquefied petroleum gas (LPG)**, and in the industrial gas industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Low pressure and high temperature**__

 __
 
• Low pressure and high temperature conditions generally favor the formation of gases rather than liquids because the molecules have high kinetic energy and are far apart.
 
 
 
• **Low pressure and low temperature**__
 __
 
• While low temperature can support liquefaction, low pressure does not help in bringing molecules close together, making it ineffective for liquefying gases.
 
 
 
• **High pressure and high temperature**__
 
 
• High pressure can promote liquefaction, but high temperature increases the kinetic energy of molecules, counteracting the effects of high pressure.

questions.question: A pair of parallel lines is intersected by a transversal such that ∠1 and ∠2 form a pair of interior angles on the same side of the transversal. If m∠1 = 65°, what is the measure of ∠2?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Interior angles on the same side** of a transversal (consecutive interior angles) between **parallel lines** are always **supplementary**.

Sum = 180°

∠2 = 180° − 65° = 115°

**∴ The correct answer is 115°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Lines are **parallel**.

m∠1 = 65°

∠1 and ∠2 are **interior angles** on the same side of the **transversal**.

**Formula Used:**

Sum of consecutive interior angles = 180°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80425589ae30d8e3237e3f1ed13e7ae32be1d21c6c285252dc7f9fd302c83dc7.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ m∠1 + m∠2 = 180°

⇒ 65° + m∠2 = 180°

⇒ m∠2 = 180° − 65°

⇒ m∠2 = 115°

**∴ The correct answer is 115°.**

Alternate Interior Angles

When parallel lines are intersected by a transversal, alternate interior angles are equal in measure.

Corresponding Angles

Angles in the same relative position at each intersection where a straight line crosses two others are equal if the lines are parallel.

Vertically Opposite Angles

When two lines intersect, the angles opposite each other at the vertex are always equal.</p

questions.question: A sum of money is to be distributed among four members A, B, C, and D in the ratio 4 : 7 : 9 : 3. If C gets Rs. 720 more than D, find D's share.
questions.solution:

Ratio of **A : B : C : D** = 4 : 7 : 9 : 3

Difference between **C** and **D** in ratio = 9 − 3 = 6 units

Given, 6 units = **Rs. 720** ⇒ 1 unit = **Rs. 120**

**D** share = 3 units = 3 × 120 = **Rs. 360**

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 360.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio of shares **A : B : C : D** = 4x : 7x : 9x : 3x

Difference between **C** share and **D** share = **Rs. 720**

⇒ 9x − 3x = 720

⇒ 6x = 720

⇒ x = 720 ÷ 6

⇒ x = 120

**D** share = 3x

⇒ 3 × 120 = 360

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 360.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion Basics

A ratio a:b represents the relative sizes of two quantities. If a total sum S is divided in ratio a:b:c, the share of the first person is (a / (a+b+c)) × S.

Difference Rule in Ratios

When the difference between two parts is given, equate the difference in ratio units to the actual value to find the value of 1 unit (x).

Total Sum Calculation

Total Sum = (Sum of all ratio parts) × Value of 1 unit. For this case: (4+7+9+3) × 120 = 23 × 120 = Rs. 2760.</p

questions.question: Which of the following is the dispersed phase of butter?

• **Butter** is an example of a **colloid**, specifically an emulsion.
 
• In a colloidal system, the **dispersed phase** is the phase that is distributed in the form of very small particles or droplets throughout the bulk of another phase, known as the **continuous phase**.
 
• In the case of butter, the continuous phase is **solid fat**.
 
• The **dispersed phase** in butter is **water**, making it a liquid.
 
• This means that the water droplets are dispersed throughout the solid fat.

__
 
• **Reduction reaction** refers to the process in which a substance **gains electrons** and decreases its oxidation state.
 
• In the **conversion of copper oxide (CuO) into copper (Cu)**, copper oxide is reduced to copper by gaining electrons.
 
• This process often involves the removal of oxygen or the addition of hydrogen.
 
• **Copper oxide** (CuO) is an inorganic compound that can be reduced to copper metal (Cu) through a reduction reaction.

• **Conversion of carbon into carbon dioxide**__
 __
 
• This is also an **oxidation reaction** where carbon (C) reacts with oxygen (O₂) to form carbon dioxide (CO₂).
 
• In this reaction, carbon undergoes oxidation by losing electrons and forming carbon dioxide.
 
 
 
• **Conversion of ethanol into acetic acid**__

questions.question:
Find the circumference of a circle that circumscribes a square of side 7 cm.

(Use π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For a **circle circumscribing a square**, the **diameter** of the circle is equal to the **diagonal** of the square.

Diagonal of square = side × √2 = 7√2 cm.

Circumference = π × diameter = (22/7) × 7√2 = 22√2 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 22√2 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Side of square (a) = 7 cm.

**Formula Used:** Diameter of circumcircle (d) = a√2; Circumference = πd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d98992889cbef6acca6b11264842fe337a4f92d7c9354ffa6f901a7dc7766287.png] 

⇒ Diagonal of the square = √(side² + side²)

⇒ Diagonal = √(7² + 7²) = √(49 + 49) = √98 = 7√2 cm

⇒ Since the square is **inscribed**, circle diameter (d) = Diagonal = 7√2 cm

⇒ Circumference = π × d

⇒ Circumference = (22/7) × 7√2

⇒ Circumference = 22√2 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 22√2 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Incircle of a Square

For a circle inscribed inside a square, the **diameter** of the circle is equal to the **side** of the square (d = a).

Area of Circumcircle

The area of the circle circumscribing a square is πr², where r = (a√2)/2. Area = πa²/2.

Ratio of Areas

The ratio of the area of the **incircle** to the area of the **circumcircle** of the same square is always 1 : 2.</p

• When a ball is dropped from a height, it initially possesses only **potential energy**.
 
• As the ball falls, the **potential energy** gradually converts into **kinetic energy**.
 
• At the midpoint of the fall, the ball has fallen through half of the total distance.
 
• At this point, it has both **potential energy** (due to the height it is still above the ground) and **kinetic energy** (due to the velocity it has gained while falling).
 
• Specifically, at the midpoint, the energies are distributed such that the sum of **potential energy** and **kinetic energy** equals the total initial potential energy.
 
• This is a direct consequence of the law of **conservation of energy**, which states that the total energy in a closed system remains constant.

• In this case, the zero position is the ground, and the ball has **potential energy** due to its height above the ground.
 
 
 
• **Kinetic Energy**__
 
 
• **Kinetic energy** is the energy an object possesses due to its motion.
 
• As the ball falls, its velocity increases, and it gains **kinetic energy**.

Combine terms using **Algebraic Identities**: (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) = a³ + b³ and (a − b)(a² + ab + b²) = a³ − b³.

Product = (a³ + b³)(a³ − b³).

2) x³ − y³ = (x − y)(x² + xy + y²)

3) (x + y)(x − y) = x² − y²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Rearranging the terms: [(a + b)(a² − ab + b²)] × [(a − b)(a² + ab + b²)]

⇒ Using identities: (a³ + b³) × (a³ − b³)

⇒ Using (x + y)(x − y) property: (a³)² − (b³)²

⇒ a⁶ − b⁶

Sum of Cubes Identity

a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²). This is a fundamental **factorization** identity.

Difference of Cubes Identity

a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²). Note the **positive middle term** in the quadratic factor.

Difference of Squares

(x + y)(x − y) = x² − y². It is used to simplify the product of **conjugate pairs**.</p

questions.question: The greatest natural number by which the product of three consecutive even natural numbers is always divisible is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Pick the smallest **three consecutive even natural numbers**: 2, 4, and 6.

Product = 2 × 4 × 6 = 48.

Since this is the smallest possible product, every subsequent product of three consecutive even numbers must be divisible by this value.

**∴ The correct answer is 48.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36c84caf1289dad6659be2ac95498a72c9f02ab7057a49ed821be3492ddced84.png] 

**Given:** Three consecutive even natural numbers.

**Formula:** Let the numbers be 2n, 2n+2, and 2n+4, where n ≥ 1.

⇒ Product (P) = 2n × 2(n+1) × 2(n+2)

⇒ P = 8 × [n × (n+1) × (n+2)]

⇒ The term [n × (n+1) × (n+2)] represents the product of **three consecutive integers**.

⇒ The product of **r** consecutive integers is always divisible by **r!** (factorial r).

⇒ So, n(n+1)(n+2) is divisible by 3! = 3 × 2 × 1 = 6.

⇒ Maximum Divisor = 8 × 6 = 48.

**∴ The correct answer is 48.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility of Consecutive Integers

The product of **n** consecutive integers is always divisible by **n!**. For example, the product of 4 consecutive integers is always divisible by 24.

Consecutive Odd Numbers

Unlike even numbers, the product of three consecutive **odd** natural numbers (e.g., 1×3×5=15) does not have a large fixed divisor other than 3 (if the sequence starts at specific points) or 1.

Sum of Consecutive Even Numbers

The sum of **n** consecutive even numbers is always divisible by **n** if n is odd, and follows specific arithmetic progression properties.</p

questions.question: Two people drive towards each other from two places which are 56 km apart. The speed of the first person is 13 km/h and speed of the other is 14 km/h. After how long will they be 2 km apart if they start driving together?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance to be covered for the 2 km gap = 56 − 2 = 54 km.

Relative speed in opposite direction = 13 + 14 = 27 kmph.

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed = 54 ÷ 27 = 2 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 hr.**

Speed 1 (S₁) = 13 km/h

Speed 2 (S₂) = 14 km/h

Time = (Total Distance − Remaining Distance) ÷ Relative Speed

⇒ Relative Speed = 13 + 14 = 27 km/h

⇒ Distance to be covered = 56 − 2 = 54 km

⇒ Time required = 54 ÷ 27

⇒ Time = 2 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 2 hr.**

questions.question: The present ages of the two people are 46 years and 60 years, respectively. If after ‘k’ years, the ratio of their ages is 4 : 5, then the value of ‘k’ is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Current **Age Difference** = 60 − 46 = 14 years.

Future **Ratio** is 4 : 5. Difference in ratio units = 5 − 4 = 1 unit.

Since the age difference remains constant: 1 unit = 14 years.

Age of younger person after k years = 4 units = 4 × 14 = 56 years.

Value of k = 56 − 46 = 10 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58856d2d66c837bdb28e439c4c204e560d285042c5cd357bd59a7ac72376aa2a.png] 

**Given:** Present ages are 46 and 60. Ratio after k years = 4 : 5.

⇒ (46 + k) ÷ (60 + k) = 4 ÷ 5

⇒ 5 × (46 + k) = 4 × (60 + k)

⇒ 230 + 5k = 240 + 4k

⇒ 5k − 4k = 240 − 230

⇒ k = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10 years.**

**__Additional Information__**

Constant Difference Property

The difference between the ages of two people remains **constant** regardless of how many years pass.

Ratio Scaling

When the difference in ratio parts does not match the actual age difference, scale the ratio by multiplying with a constant factor.

Linear Equation Approach

questions.question: The difference in the measures of two complementary angles is 18°. Find the measure of the smaller angle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For two angles whose **sum** (S) and **difference** (D) are known:

**Smaller angle** = (Sum − Difference) ÷ 2

Sum of **complementary angles** = 90° | Difference = 18°

Smaller angle = (90° − 18°) ÷ 2 = 72° ÷ 2 = 36°.

**∴ The correct answer is 36°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Two angles are **complementary**.

Difference between them = 18°.

**Formula Used:**

Sum of two **complementary angles** = 90°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf472bf6e6c6f40ebb545420ea157766db30875edfd3a647ca122ddc61d7beda.png] 

Let the two angles be **x** and **y**, where **x** is the smaller angle.

⇒ y + x = 90° --- (Equation 1)

⇒ y − x = 18° --- (Equation 2)

Subtract Equation 2 from Equation 1:

⇒ (y + x) − (y − x) = 90° − 18°

⇒ 2x = 72°

⇒ x = 72° ÷ 2

⇒ x = 36°

**∴ The correct answer is 36°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Complementary Angles

Two angles are called complementary if their sum is exactly 90°.

Supplementary Angles

Two angles are called supplementary if their sum is exactly 180°.

Linear Pair

Adjacent angles formed by intersecting lines that sum to 180° are known as a linear pair.</p

⇒ 2 + (2 − 1) − (1 + 1) + 1 = 2 + 1 − 2 + 1 = 2

⇒ Checking options for A = 45°: 2cot² 45° = 2(1)² = 2. This matches.

⇒ sec² A + (cosec² A − 1) − (1 + tan² A) + cot² A

⇒ sec² A + cot² A − sec² A + cot² A

⇒ (sec² A − sec² A) + (cot² A + cot² A)

⇒ 0 + 2cot² A

⇒ 2cot² A

questions.question: Formation of the mixture is a ________ change whereas formation of a compound is a _______ change, respectively.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**physical, chemical**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Formation of a mixture is a **physical change** because the components of the mixture retain their individual properties and can be separated by physical means.
 
• Examples of mixtures include air, salt water, and alloys. These can be separated through **physical processes** such as filtration, evaporation, and distillation.
 
• Formation of a compound is a **chemical change** because it involves the formation of new substances with different properties from the original substances.
 
• In a chemical change, the original substances undergo a **chemical reaction** and form new substances that cannot be separated by physical means.
 
• Examples of compounds include water (H₂O), carbon dioxide (CO₂), and sodium chloride (NaCl). These can only be separated into their elements by **chemical methods**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Physical Change**__

 __
 
• **Physical changes** do not alter the chemical composition of a substance.
 
• They are usually **reversible** and do not involve the formation of new substances.
 
• Examples include changes in state (melting, freezing, boiling), size (cutting, grinding), and shape.
 
 
 
• **Chemical Change**__
 
 
• **Chemical changes** result in the formation of one or more new substances with different chemical properties.
 
• They are typically **irreversible** under normal conditions.
 
• Indicators of a chemical change include color change, gas production, formation of a precipitate, and energy change (heat, light).

questions.question: If the price of milk is 15% more than that of water, then the price of water is approximately what percentage less than that of milk?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the price of water be 100 units.

Since the price of milk is 15% more, the price of milk = 115 units.

Difference in price = 115 − 100 = 15 units.

Percentage by which water is cheaper than milk = (15 ÷ 115) × 100

⇒ (3 ÷ 23) × 100 ≈ 13.04%

**∴ The correct answer is 13.04%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Price of milk is 15% more than the price of water.

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Less = (Difference in value ÷ Reference value) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3e0cee6841e4110fb30ac727191c01194b40e3d25d5d34bbf82c903616b12ac.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the price of water be x.

⇒ Price of milk = x + 15% of x = 1.15x

⇒ Difference in price = 1.15x − x = 0.15x

⇒ Here, the reference value is the price of milk because we need to find how much water is less *than milk*.

⇒ Required Percentage = (0.15x ÷ 1.15x) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = (15 ÷ 115) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = (3 ÷ 23) × 100

⇒ 300 ÷ 23 ≈ 13.04%

**∴ The correct answer is 13.04%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Base of Percentage

When calculating percentage less or more, the value that immediately follows the word 'than' acts as the base (denominator) for the entire calculation.

Direct Formula for Percentage Less

If quantity A is R% more than quantity B, then B is less than A by [(R ÷ (100 + R)) × 100]%. Substituting R = 15 directly yields the required value.

Direct Formula for Percentage More

Conversely, if quantity A is R% less than quantity B, then B is more than A by [(R ÷ (100 − R)) × 100]%.
</p

questions.question:
The following observations are arranged in ascending order.

29, 32, 48, 50, x, 2x + 3, 72, 78, 84, 95

If the median is 63, then the value of x is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Number of observations (n) = 10 (even).

Median = Average of (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms.

Median = Average of 5th and 6th terms = (x + 2x + 3) ÷ 2 = 63.

3x + 3 = 126 ⇒ 3x = 123 ⇒ x = 41.

**∴ The correct answer is 41.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07266aa9521d9d5c5073a9b9ae5a8133620a9cf48ff6ca2a142acc655497bc4c.png] 

**Given:** Observations = 29, 32, 48, 50, x, 2x + 3, 72, 78, 84, 95 (in ascending order)

**Formula Used:** For even n, Median = [(n/2)th term + (n/2 + 1)th term] ÷ 2

⇒ Number of observations n = 10

⇒ Median = (5th term + 6th term) ÷ 2

⇒ 63 = [x + (2x + 3)] ÷ 2

⇒ 63 × 2 = 3x + 3

⇒ 126 = 3x + 3

⇒ 3x = 126 − 3

⇒ 3x = 123

⇒ x = 41

**∴ The correct answer is 41.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Median for Odd Data

If the number of observations (n) is odd, the median is the exactly middle term, given by [(n+1)/2]th term.

Mean Calculation

Mean is the sum of all observations divided by the total number of observations: Mean = (Σxᵢ) ÷ n.

Empirical Formula

The relationship between Mean, Median, and Mode is: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.</p

questions.question: Which of the following holds for the parallel combination of resistors?

options.text: The total resistance is equal to the highest resistance.
The total resistance is always less than the smallest resistance.
The total resistance is always greater than the smallest resistance.
The total resistance is equal to the smallest resistance.

questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**The total resistance is always less than the smallest resistance.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In a **parallel combination** of resistors, the total or equivalent resistance is always less than the **smallest individual resistance**.
 
• This is because the overall effect of adding more paths (resistors) for the current to flow through results in a lower total resistance.
 
• 
 
To calculate the total resistance for two resistors in parallel, you can use the formula:

 
1 / (1 / R1 + 1 / R2)

 
Where R1 is the resistance of the first resistor and R2 is the resistance of the second resistor.

 
For example, if you have two resistors, one with a resistance of 6 ohms and the other with 3 ohms, the calculation would be:

 
1 / (1 / 6 + 1 / 3)

 
First, calculate the individual fractions:

 
1 / 6 = 0.1667

 1 / 3 = 0.3333

 
Now add them together:

 
0.1667 + 0.3333 = 0.5

 
Finally, take the reciprocal of the result:

 
1 / 0.5 = 2

 
So, the total resistance for the two resistors in parallel is 2 ohms.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The total resistance is equal to the highest resistance.**__

 __
 
• In a parallel combination, this statement is incorrect. The total resistance is never equal to the highest resistance.
 
• The total resistance in parallel is always lower than the smallest resistance in the network.
 
 
 
• **The total resistance is always greater than the smallest resistance.**__
 __
 
• This statement is incorrect for parallel combinations. The total resistance is always less than the smallest resistance.
 
 
 
• **The total resistance is equal to the smallest resistance.**__
 
 
• This statement is incorrect as well. The total resistance in a parallel circuit is always less than the smallest individual resistance.

questions.question: A, B, and C alone can do a piece of work in 9, 12 and 18 days, respectively. They all started the work together, but A left after 3 days. In how many days, was the total work completed?

__Shortcut Trick__

Let **Total Work** (LCM of 9, 12, 18) = 36 units.

Efficiencies: A = 4, B = 3, C = 2. Total efficiency = 9.

Work done by all in 3 days = 9 × 3 = 27 units.

Remaining work = 36 − 27 = 9 units.

Time taken by B and C for remaining work = 9 ÷ (3 + 2) = 1.8 days.

Total time = 3 + 1.8 = 4.8 days = 24/5 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 24/5 days.**

**Given:** A, B and C can do work in 9, 12 and 18 days.

Prime Number Definition
